∀ {ι : Type} {G : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Geometry}
  {c : NavierStokes.CorrectionState.Context NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint}
  {primary : ι → NavierStokes.CorrectionState.HarmonicBlock NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint}
  {P : ι → ℕ → NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint → ℝ}
  {labelCarrier : ι → ℕ → Set NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CyclePoint} {σ : ℝ}
  {x : NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleState ι},
  NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleRepresentation x.coefficients x.state x.axisymmetricAlias →
    NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CoefficientBands x.coefficients →
      NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleRealCoefficients x.coefficients →
        (∀ (l : ι),
            NavierStokes.HarmonicSourceSupport.InputSupportOn G.domain (labelCarrier l) (x.coefficients.blocks l)
              (x.coefficients.gaussian l) (x.coefficients.aliasCoefficients l)) →
          (∀ (l : ι),
              (NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.residualBlock c x.state (x.coefficients.blocks l)
                    (x.coefficients.gaussian l) (x.coefficients.aliasCoefficients l)).BandLimited
                x.coefficients.residualBand) →
            (∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.HarmonicWaveInteraction.ZeroMode (x.coefficients.blocks l)) →
              (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ((x.coefficients.blocks l).pressure n).coeff 0 = 0) →
                (∀ (l : ι), NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.SameCarrier (x.coefficients.blocks l) (primary l)) →
                  (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) ((x.coefficients.blocks l).phase n) G.strip.domain) →
                    (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), (x.coefficients.blocks l).frequency n ≠ 0) →
                      (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ), (x.coefficients.blocks l).angularFrequency n ≠ 0) →
                        (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
                            NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.SmoothCoefficients G.domain
                              ((x.coefficients.blocks l).velocity n i)) →
                          (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ),
                              NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.SmoothCoefficients G.domain
                                ((x.coefficients.blocks l).pressure n)) →
                            (∀ (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin 3),
                                NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.SmoothCoefficients G.domain
                                  (x.coefficients.gaussian l n i)) →
                              (∀ (l : ι),
                                  NavierStokes.HarmonicWaveInteraction.ModeSolenoidal G.strip c
                                    (x.coefficients.blocks l)) →
                                (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                    NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass G.strip P (1 / 2)
                                      fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                                      ((x.coefficients.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j z) →
                                  (∀ (j : ℤ),
                                      NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass G.strip P 1
                                        fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                                        ((x.coefficients.blocks l).pressure n).coeff j z) →
                                    (∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                        NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformWaveClass G.strip P (17 / 25)
                                          fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ) (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                                          ((x.coefficients.blocks l).velocity n i).coeff j z -
                                            ((primary l).velocity n i).coeff j z) →
                                      NavierStokes.CorrectionState.CumulativeBounds G.strip x.state →
                                        (∀ (i j : Fin 3),
                                            NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.MeanClass G.strip 1 (x.state.covariance i j)) →
                                          (NavierStokes.UniformHarmonicInteraction.UniformVelocity G.strip P (1 / 2 + σ)
                                              fun (l : ι) =>
                                              NavierStokes.HarmonicResidual.residualBlock c x.state
                                                (x.coefficients.blocks l) (x.coefficients.gaussian l)
                                                (x.coefficients.aliasCoefficients l)) →
                                            NavierStokes.CorrectionState.MeanResidualBounds G.strip σ c x.state →
                                              NavierStokes.LiftedMeanResidual.MeanHypotheses G.strip.domain c x.state →
                                                NavierStokes.CorrectionState.DefectBounds G.slowStrip σ c x.state →
                                                  NavierStokes.MeanStateRegularity.PrimitiveData G.region G.patch.a
                                                      G.patch.b c x.state →
                                                    NavierStokes.VariableGaugeMean.reconstructState G.gauge c x.state =
                                                        x.state →
                                                      NavierStokes.GaugeMassPreservation.ZeroMassesOn G.region.carrier
                                                          x.state →
                                                        NavierStokes.WaveStateRegularity.AngularSmooth G.domain
                                                            x.state.oscillation →
                                                          (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (x.state.oscillatoryPressure n)
                                                                (G.domain ×ˢ Set.univ)) →
                                                            NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.OscillationPeriodic
                                                                G.region.carrier x.state.oscillation →
                                                              NavierStokes.WaveStateRegularity.WaveSupport G.region
                                                                  G.patch.a G.patch.b x.state.oscillation →
                                                                (∀ (β : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (j : ℤ),
                                                                    NavierStokes.LabelSumBounds.UniformClass G.strip
                                                                      (fun (x : ι) (x_1 : ℕ)
                                                                          (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                                                                        √(G.strip.zeta z))
                                                                      β
                                                                      fun (l : ι) (n : ℕ)
                                                                        (z : NavierStokes.SignedMeanGain.Point) =>
                                                                      (x.coefficients.gaussian l n i).coeff j z) →
                                                                  NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.angularMeanVector
                                                                        x.state.errors.gaussian =
                                                                      0 →
                                                                    (∀ (l : ι),
                                                                        x.coefficients.aliasCoefficients l = 0) →
                                                                      (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                                          NavierStokes.WeightedClasses.MeanClass G.strip
                                                                            β x.axisymmetricAlias) →
                                                                        (∀ (n : ℕ),
                                                                            ∀ z ∈ G.domain,
                                                                              ∀ (i : Fin 3),
                                                                                Continuous fun (θ : ℝ) =>
                                                                                  x.state.errors.base n (z, θ) i) →
                                                                          NavierStokes.CorrectionStep.CycleAnalyticInvariant
                                                                            G c primary P labelCarrier σ x
